**Date:** {{< meta display-date >}}  
**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear [Mr Bullock](../persons.html#221),
I will try to do [Raymond Lull](../books.html#358) in short by the end of next week, I have both the books.[^2]
You will be glad to hear that I have had a cheerful letter from Miss [Florence Wilford](../persons.html#1520) well, and at home with her [sister](../persons.html#1519)[^3]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Envelope addressed to ‘The Revd J.F.

Bullock/Radwinter Rectory/Saffron Walden.’ Postmark MR 16/95.

[^2]: Raymond Lull (1232-1315), missionary and philosopher.

[^3]: Florence Wilford seems to have been confined in a lunatic asylum in later life.
